segments.title: ChatGPT voice changes Dec 11
segments.say: ChatGPT is retiring two voice modes on December eleventh.

segments.title: What's going
segments.say: OpenAI says Advanced and Standard voice go away on December eleventh.

segments.title: Everyone moves to GPT-Live
segments.say: Everyone moves to GPT-Live, launched in July.

segments.title: What's different
segments.say: Live listens while it talks, so you can cut in.

segments.title: One catch
segments.say: One catch: OpenAI says Live can't do video or screen share yet.

segments.title: Your old chats stay
segments.say: Your old chats stay in your history.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to a friend who talks to ChatGPT daily, and follow Nexora.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
